title: [Control Systems] Inductive Automation security advisory (AV26-892)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-892 Date: September 8, 2026 As of September 4, 2026, Inductive Automation is affected by a vulnerability in the following product: Ignition Prior to or equal to 8.1.53 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
